messages.subject: Re: rmr package installation problem
parts:
The only thing I can think of is to compare Rcpp version and gcc version on all three machines and see if we can spot a difference. Sometimes it looks like some neutrinos are hitting the CPU at the wrong time but more often it turns out that perfectly aligned systems are, well, not so perfectly aligned. But I'd be surprised if it compiled only one one specific version of Rcpp, which is not a bleeding edge package, I would say fairly stable at this point. But one user actually managed to find a gcc bug compiling rmr, so we need to be ready for anything.



Antonio

messages.author: a24cf75cdaf35de4
messages.subject: Re: rmr package installation problem
parts:
Antonio!! Thanks for the quick response.

As you suspected there was an incompatibility of version.
Although gcc version were the same, for some reason Rcpp got updated to v0.10.0 and rmr2 was not installing properly.
Removed that version and downloaded v0.9.15 (the same that the other nodes had) and installed it through command line.

After that rmr got installed properly.

Thanks for your help and hope this issue helps out someone else.

Maybe rmr2 package need a compatibility update!

Thanks again.
